g.text: Custom deploy/Dockerfile.nginx C-module • Non-blocking if collector is offline
Sanitizes http.request.header.authorization before export • Traces, Metrics, Logs
opentelemetry-instrument celery • Async tasks, FTS, covers & federation
treat RUM fields as untrusted input
or LogQL lock-in for SREs & AI agents
